title: Sahte Güz 1
author: Beyza Özaydın
description: Series synopsis: Drawn into a dangerous web of deception and manipulation, Derin assumes the identity of Kumsal in a mental hospital, where ruthless games blur the lines between love, hate, and survival. Caught in a battle of wits with the enigmatic Savaş Atan, she soon discovers that every move has consequences, and that Kumsal’s hidden influence may destroy her. As alliances shift and the shadows of the past grow darker, Derin and Savaş find themselves unexpectedly on the same side, unraveling the truth behind the games and confronting the secrets that bind them.
